messages:
maria: FYI my PR for the nv4 pool hits premerge OPA errors during our freeze window, blocking a small canary. need advice on safest path forward. PR: https://git.company/pr/8421 :grimacing:
ci-bot: premerge check failed: policy 'network-egress-allowlist' rejected change. error: 'egress to 10.200.0.0/16 not allowed by org policy'
kevin: which change added that egress? can you paste the helm values diff?
maria: it's the kubeproxy egress for the new gpu-node-pool autoscaler webhook. snippet from values: ```yaml
nodePools:
  gpu-nv4b-canary:
    min: 1
    max: 4
    tags:
      - gpu
    egressCIDRs:
      - 10.200.0.0/16
```
cloudops: we didn't authorize new internal egress ranges during freeze window. this needs a security review normally.
maria: understood. this is a tiny canary to validate burst scaling only, will not be exposed to internet. need a temporary approval or a patch to avoid changing egress while still allowing the canary.
josh: two options: 1) strip egressCIDRs from the helm values for now and run the canary with default networking, or 2) request a short freeze exception with explicit reviewers.
sre-oncall: if we go option 1, confirm that autoscaler webhook still works without that egress allowed. if webhook talks to internal monitoring in that CIDR, it might fail. quick test would be to run helm template locally with the cluster overrides.
maria: manual test shows webhook logs are fine without explicit egress; it's allowed via svc-cluster internal routes. the egress was an overzealous add from the upstream chart.
kevin: ok if it's just a chart default let's remove the value in the values.yaml and push a new commit. add an annotation so we remember to revert after the freeze: `infra/temporary-override: "nv4b-canary-no-egress"`
cloudops: I can fast-track a short exception for emergency if you need it, but prefer minimizing approvals. ensure you add the change to the rollout ticket and tag product-owners.
maria: will remove the egress line and push, and open a follow-up issue to reintroduce proper egress after freeze. tagging @kevin and @josh in the ticket. pushing now.
ci-bot: re-run queued checks for PR #8421
ci-bot: premerge check passed: all policies green :white_check_mark:
kevin: :thumbsup: good call. please also include a note in the k8s-gitops channel once the canary is live so infra teams can watch GPU pool scaling.
maria: will do. thanks everyone :heart:
